title: Quickstart mini-gallery: KV-cache trace waterfall + cost sparklines
creator: Amina Patel
description: Asset pack for documentation and console quickstart: a collection of compact screenshots and annotated frames illustrating latency distributions, per-route cost-per-token sparklines, KV cache hit-rate overlays, and a trace waterfall highlighting model shard timings and prefix cache benefits. Intended for the 'Observability Quickstart' doc, SDK onboarding, and release notes hero images.
acceptance_criteria: 8 finalized PNG/JPG export files in Drive with 2x and 3x density variants
All assets annotated with callouts for copy team and product docs
Figma styles updated to match Console theme tokens
PM sign-off on hero image and one hero storyboard for quickstart page
